comment: Drop this into a project's .claude/settings.json to snapshot the raw transcript before compaction. This file uses the macOS/Linux command: python3 and $HOME. On Windows, replace python3 with python and keep $HOME; both Git Bash and PowerShell expand it. Both auto and manual compaction create snapshots only. Snapshots land in <project>/docs/acc/_snapshots/ (gitignored, newest 5 kept). Operational failures are reported on stderr but exit 0 so they do not block compaction.
